slots.caption: A big spinning ball curls around the wall and past Chalk.
Seen from above, the curler starts wide and bends into the goal.
Chalk's view: the ball swings wide, then curls into the corner.
One huge spinning ball with its white line and spin arrows.
Three balls show three kicks and their three different spins.
Tavi kneels at night and draws the white line on the ball.
The shot flies over the bar and Tavi shouts at it.
A low, hard shot beats Chalk's late dive into the corner.
Tavi jumps for joy after the same shot hits the net.
The foot touches the ball for only a hundredth of a second.
A race where the kicked ball flies faster than the foot.
Tavi's volley: about one in five big-tournament goals are volleys.
